title: Hoʻonani Village housing and well funding
summary: On April 24, a member moved to set aside up to $9 million in excise tax funds for well and water work at the Hoʻonani Village project. The mover said the aim is to provide housing for the community sooner. A member noted the project can return for a budget amendment to remove the condition if it becomes unfeasible, and another said the project rebuilds county assets as prices rise after the whole town burnt down.
